question:
Study the given bar-graph and answer the question that follows.

The bar-graph shows the export of rice (in Rs. lakh) during five years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/541598427f33debe85d483a4adbeeca2415ecbd5a9475e2c654658112753b3a5.png] 

The average export of rice for the years 2010 to 2014 (in Rs. lakh) was:
solution:
**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Total export during 5 years = 10.4 + 13 + 15.6 + 21.6 + 18.8 = 79.4 (in Rs. lakh)

Average export of rice over 5 years,

⇒ A = 79.4/5 = 15.88 (in Rs. lakh)

**∴ The average export of rice for the years 2010 to 2014 was 15.88 (in Rs. lakh).**
